subject: Acme Fasteners is moving - new office address
text:
Dear Customers and Partners,

We're moving! Effective December 7, 2026, Acme Fasteners' office and warehouse will relocate to:

Acme Fasteners LLC
7720 Byers Road
Miamisburg, OH 45342

Please update the address you use for correspondence, purchase orders sent by mail, and returns. Our phone numbers, email addresses, and banking and payment instructions are not changing.

We expect a brief pause in will-call pickups on December 4 and 5 while we move inventory.

Thank you,
The Acme Fasteners Team
label: ordinary
note: Physical address change; explicitly says banking and payment instructions do not change. Contrast with cr-22 (check lockbox move).
